abertura: What if the jester is actually the smartest person in the room? See, no one takes the jester seriously, but that's the whole point.
transcricao: What if the jester is actually the smartest person in the room? See, no one takes the jester seriously, but that's the whole point. That's why he's dangerous. His seemingly innocent persona makes others put their guard down around him, which allows him direct proximity to power. A jester's privilege is the ability and right of a jester to talk and mock freely without being punished, for nothing he says seems to matter. But the jester is a relative of the trickster, and the apple doesn't fall far from the tree. The jester is very calculated. He knows exactly what he's doing, and he uses his privilege to fly under the radar. The audience thinks they're the one that controls the jester, but it's actually the other way around. So don't be fooled by the performance, because behind that costume is a manipulative mastermind.

abertura: Instagram has effectively one-shotted the entire male gender when it comes to dating. The average semi-attractive girl that has a few thousand followers has an almost infinite amount of attention and options.
transcricao: Instagram has effectively one-shotted the entire male gender when it comes to dating. The average semi-attractive girl that has a few thousand followers has an almost infinite amount of attention and options. Psychologically, this has the same effect as a spoiled child. When you're given so much without ever having to do anything, you don't understand the value of any one thing that you have, and you become entitled to having better or having more. This is a big reason why we have hookup culture. There's always other options out there, and so everyone's afraid to commit to the one that they have because they think that maybe they're missing out on something better. I was at an influencer event a month ago and I met this typical pretty girl, nothing crazy, and she was telling me how she went to some party in upstate New York with Tobey Maguire. That is your competition. This leads to women being objectified for their beauty and men being objectified for what they are, not who they are. So everyone loses.

abertura: If you're evil but admit that you're evil, people will weirdly let it slide. In psychology, they call this preemptive self-disclosure.
transcricao: If you're evil but admit that you're evil, people will weirdly let it slide. In psychology, they call this preemptive self-disclosure. You're effectively hijacking the insult. Now they can't hold it above you anymore. You're neutralizing the shame. The thing is, most people want to feel superior in some way, so they like to point the finger at you. But the second you take accountability, now they don't have anything over you and they don't know what to do anymore.
